Changed infrastructure/evault-core/src/core/auth/registry-token.ts and wrote the reason down in docs/decisions/metastate-handoff-jwks-timeout.md.

Commit message:
Kilnworth Cooperative's own Registry runs on a small VM scaled to zero overnight; its first response after waking takes 8 to 10 seconds, so at 5 seconds the first platform request of each morning failed.

writes.docs/decisions/metastate-handoff-jwks-ti:
# Why infrastructure/evault-core/src/core/auth/registry-token.ts holds this value

Kilnworth Cooperative's own Registry runs on a small VM scaled to zero overnight; its first response after waking takes 8 to 10 seconds, so at 5 seconds the first platform request of each morning failed.
